text:
Good morning, love. You had a rough night, so this is short and soft, and you can read it with one eye open.

Last night you went to a party, got handed the hardest person at the table, and still came home happy. Then you looked at your mother, said "no, chicken fingers," and walked out into the night. I want that sentence framed. It's the most you thing you've ever said.

Today's the big one. The ceremony's outside and the sun goes down early, so wear a real coat over that dress and don't let anyone tell you otherwise. The wrap and the heels come out once you're inside. Check the ground before you trust the stilettos. Keep your flats in the car.

You don't owe the difficult one your whole evening. Be kind for a little while, then go find the dessert table, or your mom, or a dress worth reporting back to me.

What I want for you tonight: one moment where you look around that room and think, I look good, and I'm happy, and I don't have to do anything.

Then come home and tell me everything.

I love you. Drink some water first.
